overview_description.description: Helsing develops artificial intelligence software, autonomous systems, and defense technologies for military and government applications. Its products include AI-enabled software for reconnaissance, electronic warfare, underwater surveillance, autonomous aircraft, and strike drone operations, along with systems that connect existing defense equipment into AI-enabled networks. The company also designs autonomous air, land, and underwater platforms that support data processing, mission planning, and operational decision-making. In addition, Helsing works with government and industry partners to integrate AI capabilities into defense infrastructure and supports the development and deployment of software-defined autonomous systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Helsing develops artificial intelligence software, autonomous systems, and defense technologies for military and government applications.

product.name: CA-1 Europa
product.description: An autonomous, multi-mission combat aircraft in the three-to-five-ton class, designed for scalable deployment, onboard AI, and operations in contested airspace.

product.name: Altra
product.description: A software-defined reconnaissance and strike system that integrates ISR data, AI mission planning, command and control, artillery fire correction, and autonomous strike-drone operations.

product.name: HX-2
product.description: An AI-enabled strike drone designed for autonomous mission execution and precision engagement in contested operating environments.

product.name: SG-1 + Lura
product.description: An underwater autonomous surveillance system combining mass-deployable SG-1 Fathom subsurface gliders with Lura software for edge-based acoustic detection, classification, and mission management.

product.name: Cirra
product.description: An AI-based electronic-warfare system that evaluates emitter signals, classifies unknown anti-aircraft threats, and supports threat recognition during and after missions.

product.name: Centaur
product.description: An AI pilot and mission software stack for autonomous air operations, providing decision-making and tactical execution for combat aircraft and other aerial systems.
